description: After check_availability and the guest's choice: pass house, room_id or room_type, rate_id, dates and guests as returned. Checks again and returns a summary (room, dates, guests, total EUR) and checkout_url, where the guest enters details and pays. Show the summary, then give the guest checkout_url. Does not book, hold or charge. Never ask the guest for card details. Errors: NOT_AVAILABLE with alternatives, BOOKING_NOT_YET_ONLINE.

departure.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD, after the arrival.

house.description: House from the booking option: hotel, chalet or motel (mondschein = hotel). Optional with room_id.

language.description: Language of texts and links: de, nl, en. Default de.

rate_id.description: rate_id from booking_options of check_availability, e.g. base.

room_id.description: Room id from check_availability, e.g. comfort-double.

room_type.description: Room type code from booking_options, e.g. DZC. Give room_id, room_type or both.

name: start_booking

code.description: Error code when ok is false, e.g. VALIDATION, NOT_FOUND, UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: Readable error message when ok is false.

ok.description: true on success; false with code and message on an error.

title: Prepare a checkout link
